messages:
Maria: Heads up — discovered a permissions regression on staging: Accounts with the viewer role can open Console > Billing > Cost breakdown. Repro steps attached in thread. Could be role matrix remapping after yesterday's console deploy. Anyone on RBAC changes?

Josh: ugh, thanks for catching. I pushed the new role crosswalk to staging in the deploy earlier. I thought we blocked billing rows for viewer. I'll check the mapping. Which org IDs you repro on?

Maria: orgs: rwd-stg-47 and rwd-qa-3. Steps: log in as viewer@org, try nav -> Billing -> Cost breakdown, page renders with token-level cost graphs. Quick log: `GET /api/v1/billing/summary 200 (user.role=viewer)` — looks like permission check returned 200.

Anita: tagging in audit question — we need event for this access. If viewer is hitting billing we should see an audit log entry and the RBAC decision trace. Can you grab the /audit events? Also, does KMS-encryption of billing keys show any access logs?

Eli-SRE: deploy-bot shows the crosswalk PR was merged 3:22am. We have a canary on 10% that got routed to staging. I can revert the mapping or hotfix the policy check. Quick patch to guard server-side may be less risky.

Kevin: If server-side check was bypassed then UI gating isn't sufficient anyway. We should treat this as P1 for exposure of billing data. Possible vectors: 1) role->permission map missing `billing.view`, 2) route-level middleware not wired, 3) front-end accidentally surfaced the data from cached API.

Josh: I pulled the crosswalk diff: the new role aliasing sets `viewer` -> ['read_only', 'basic'] and `billing.view` got assigned only to `basic` on the old matrix. The new translation dropped `billing.view` from `read_only`. That would explain it but in the opposite direction (i.e., would remove access). Strange.

Maria: I saved HAR and backend headers: X-RW-Decision: allow, source: policy-cache, policy-id: crosswalk-v2. So the cache is serving an allow from an older policy. Maybe cache invalidation failed.

sec-bot: New vuln-ticket created: VULN-2026-092 (exposed billing in staging). Severity: medium. Assigned: Josh, Anita. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/vulns/VULN-2026-092

Anita: For triage: capture exact request id, user id, and `X-RW-Decision` trace. We also need KMS logs for any key usage on billing key during those requests. If KMS shows decrypt during a viewer request, escalate.

Eli-SRE: Repro confirmed. I'm rolling a hotfix to invalidate `policy-cache` on the auth service and forcing policy reload. Rolling now. deploy-bot: canary rollback triggered.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for service=console-auth, rollout_id=rl-2026-114. Expected completion in ~90s. :gear:
notes: Contains short Slack-style messages with code/log snippets and internal links. No title field per agents.md rules.
